fieldValues.title: Missing field labels could be filled from field names in one pass
fieldValues.summary: Most missing labels are a field name read aloud (unresolved_questions → Unresolved questions). A one-pass fill gives every field a readable label, to be improved by hand where the name is not the reader's word.
evidence: Audit 2026-10-30 L1: programme 39% of 215 fields, muSrs 46% of 358 fields, handbook 82% of 28 fields
srs-context convention 04f2384a: an additive optional field that only aids discovery updates in place, without a version bump
fieldValues.body:
The labels live in the shared packages (the clerk's governance, method and programme packages; muDemocracy's argument package), so the fill is a package change in each, released as usual.

Done for the clerk's method and programme packages (clerk#248, method 1.1.1, programme 0.3.1); the programme now runs method 1.1.1. Still open: the argument and comments packages (muDemocracy), and the programme's methodology package, which is installed at 0.2.0, behind the clerk's 0.3.0, so upgrading it also brings 0.3.0's changes and is left for a deliberate upgrade.
